{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK, but objected that ungenerated secnonces cause assertion aborts and suggested improving multi-participant paths"
    },
    {
      "login": "brunoerg",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; suggested additional assertions on signature and pubkey aggregation, and asked about length control"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:5141721593",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The fuzz harness aborts on random input due to libsecp256k1 illegal argument assertions when passing never-generated secnonces, breaking oss-fuzz runs",
      "quote": "The target aborts on 8 of 1000 files, with `[libsecp256k1] illegal argument: secp256k1_memcmp_var(&secnonce->data[0], secp256k1_musig_secnonce_magic, 4) == 0`.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "call dropped from the harness",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5592876523",
        "c:5593029949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5592876523",
      "status_by_quote": "Yes, I think this is a better approach. I've dropped that call from this harness."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3957935776",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Generate participant keys and nonces via CreateMuSig2Nonce and feed partial signatures into aggregation so multi-participant paths are exercised, keeping raw bytes as a separate case",
      "quote": "Worth going that way and keeping the raw bytes as a separate case, so the parse failure stays reachable?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented the suggestion in the push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3962910144",
        "c:5593029949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3962910144",
      "status_by_quote": "Ahh, makes sense, thanks! I think I've understood and taken your suggestions."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3957935789",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Drop the ser length check as ser is always 33 bytes when expected has a value",
      "quote": "This `ser` only exists when `expected` has a value, and then it comes from the aggregate pubkey, which is always 33 bytes. Could the check go?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "check removed as requested",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3958943508",
        "c:5593029949"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3958943508",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4337642472",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Assert that CreateMuSig2AggregateSig succeeds once every partial signature has succeeded",
      "quote": "I think this target could be improved to check that once every partial signature has succeeded, the aggregate then succeeds.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4337665162",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Check that the secnonce is valid after a successful CreateMuSig2PartialSig",
      "quote": "I think the target could check that the `secnonce` is valid after a successful `CreateMuSig2PartialSig`.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4337721352",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Check that MuSig2AggregatePubkeys is rejected when given a wrong expected aggregate",
      "quote": "It could check the call is rejected when it creates a wrong expected aggregate?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4337757483",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Has the author tested the target with -max_len=4096 -len_control=0 to ensure tweaks are reachable?",
      "quote": "Have you tried with `-max_len=4096 -len_control=0`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5141721593",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "The four signing functions in the module have no unit test today, only the `wallet_musig.py` functional test, so the harness covers ground that was empty.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": [
        "never-generated secnonce arm"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6317687487",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Re-classified rc:3957935776 as a suggestion under the current rules, added jeanpablojp's suggestion rc:3957935789, and recorded brunoerg's Concept ACK alongside his four suggestions and questions.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to brunoerg's suggestions and question regarding harness assertions and length control",
      "id": "rc:4337642472"
    }
  ]
}
